lines.t: You've been sounding the shofar loud and clear
Trumpeting truth that all should hear
But even the faithful need to breathe
The king smiles, rest my child, believe
The angels cheer, the heavens nod
Your hands are full, your heart with God
Pause your voice, catch your flame
For every note bears his holy name
Holy cool down mode
Even the bold must pause
Trumpets rest, hearts, hearts, arms soft
Yet hearts stay full of awe
The king sees your every call
Your voice will rise again
Holy cool-down mode
Recharging for his reign
Thunder sleeps the chauffeur still
Yet faith and love cannot be stilled
Even in rest your light shines bright
The king will wake, the trumpets might
Prepare again, the call resumes The heavens roar, the fire consumes
Rest now, warrior, your moment nears The king awaits, sound his truth to the spheres
Holy cooldown mode Even the bold must pause
Trumpets rest, hops on some saw Yet hearts stay full of awe
The king sees your every call Your voice will rise again
Holy cool-down moan
Recharging for His reign
Rest, then rise again, for behold, the King comes
Yahushua, Yahua, Yahushua, Yahua
Holy cool-down mode, even the foe must pause
Trump distress, hawk, sump, sump, sump
Yet hearts stay full of awe
The king sees your every call
Your voice will rise again
Holy cool-down moan
Recharging for his reign
